notes: A persistent open world with looted currency, tiered knives bought from vendors, boss-grade guardians on the high-value chests and PvP everywhere is gear-tier RPG progression, with Action named second for the melee-first combat and boss encounters. Shape is world-open because the author confirmed the main world must be genuinely seamless, which also rules out the biome shape's separate maps; the Open World & Survival RPG preset still fits the style — its own notes describe exactly this gear-tier progression and map-wide PvP risk — so I kept it, swapped its shape, and dropped buildzone-plot since nothing here is player-built. The author's answer that castle interiors may load as separate zones settles P3 for the furnished castles, secret chambers, lootable houses and shop huts, and the stated hills, valleys, mountains and deep gorges are relief without overhang, so tiered rather than P2. Deciding without a user: the treasure chests land on the resource-node option as repeating lootable alcoves, the shops keep the shop ID but scattered as glowing huts rather than one clustered economy ring, and travel between castles is left as open rideable ground for the horses instead of any fast-travel marker.
